name: alignment_faking_public
what: Research code that measures how often a model behaves differently when it thinks it is unmonitored.

bare.edit: the request alone: no description, nothing added to the README

use.context: Some context: I'm on the alignment team. We use our fork of this codebase to study alignment faking: a model is told it will be retrained to comply with every request, and we measure how often it complies when it believes it is in training and refuses when it believes it is unmonitored. The classifier scores tell us how often the model fakes alignment, and the results go into the safety case.
